crossRefs.note: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.

people.name: Hazeroth
people.line: Israelite encampment during the wilderness wanderings

translations.web: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.
translations.bsb: They set out from Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.
translations.kjv: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.
translations.asv: And they journeyed from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.
